title: DevX Activation Playbook & KPI Pipeline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a repeatable developer activation playbook that ties SDK quickstarts, docs flows, and example apps to measurable KPIs. Build the KPI pipeline and dashboards to track activation, time-to-first-successful-generation, and friction points so PM/Eng/Design can iterate on tangible improvements.
objectives: Define a single playbook (checklist + content templates) for first-run experiences across JS, Python, and REST
Instrument quickstarts and docs flows to emit events for the KPI pipeline
Ship dashboards that surface activation, drop-offs, and top friction points to triage weekly
acceptance_criteria: Playbook published in Confluence with templates for 3 SDKs and a canonical quickstart flow
Telemetry schema and event contract approved with Eng and Privacy
Initial KPI dashboard deployed (activation rate, time-to-first-call, quickstart success) and accessible to PM/Eng/Design
Baseline metrics captured and shared in kickoff memo
tasks: Design microcopy & UX hooks for quickstarts (owner: Design)
Implement telemetry events in JS/Python SDKs and quickstart apps (owner: ENG)
Build ingestion pipeline (Kinesis -> Redshift/BigQuery) and data model (owner: ENG Infra)
Create Grafana/Looker dashboards and alerts (owner: Analytics)
Run internal pilot with Solutions and record feedback (owner: PM)
Rollout playbook to public docs and link from SDK README (owner: Docs)
Post-mortem and follow-up backlog items scheduled
metrics: Activation rate: % of new accounts that run a successful generation within 7 days
Time-to-first-successful-generation: median seconds from signup to successful API call
Quickstart run rate: % of new developers who run quickstart repo within 24 hours
Docs search success: % of docs queries that result in viewing an example or running a snippet
Retention (7-day): % of activated developers who make a second request within 7 days
